purpose: Define the provisional provenance carrier, outer recoupling relation, and collapse conditions for typed zero-conditions 0_minus and 0_plus.

carrier.name: Typed-Zero Provenance Carrier
carrier.definition: A typed record attached to a locally collapsed zero-condition that preserves role polarity, source expression lineage, collapse context, and admissibility context without treating zero as an independent object.

typed_zero_conditions.meaning: Collapsed zero-condition retaining minus-directed provenance from its source trace.
typed_zero_conditions.lawful_use: May participate in higher-order RT only when recoupled with an oppositely typed zero-condition under the declared typed-zero recoupling relation.

typed_zero_conditions.meaning: Collapsed zero-condition retaining plus-directed provenance from its source trace.
typed_zero_conditions.lawful_use: May participate in higher-order RT only when recoupled with an oppositely typed zero-condition under the declared typed-zero recoupling relation.

outer_recoupling_relation.reading: A typed meta-relation family instance that compares oppositely typed zero-condition carriers under a declared recoupling context y.
outer_recoupling_relation.admission_rule: The recoupled expression is an RT_admissible_candidate only if both carriers are complete, polarities are opposite, context y is declared, and PRIN_001 trace-admissibility is preserved.
outer_recoupling_relation.non_promotion_note: This relation defines a provisional admissibility candidate only; it does not prove higher-order RT support or promote OPEN_BRIDGE_002 to SUPPORTED.

collapse_conditions.collapse_consequence: 0_untyped cannot participate as typed evidence in higher-order RT recoupling and must be treated as outside the distinction domain unless a new lawful asymmetric recoupling event is supplied.

remaining_validation_obligations: Validate that TZR carrier fields are sufficient for all uses of 0_minus and 0_plus in nested RT traces.
Audit existing <g>_y and <*>_x usages for compatibility with typed-zero recoupling.
Construct a PRIN_001 trace example showing lawful typed-zero recoupling without identity collapse.
Construct a counterexample showing collapse to 0_untyped when provenance fields are missing.
